# Risky paths: a change to any file matching one of these globs goes through
# the gauntlet (.github/workflows/gauntlet.yml, explained in docs/GAUNTLET.md).
#
# One glob per line, relative to the repo root. `*` matches within one folder,
# `**` matches any number of folders. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
# A `## ` line starts an area; the gauntlet's summary names the area each
# changed file falls in. Keep the list grounded in code that can lose files,
# break data or open a hole, not in whole packages for convenience.

## Deletes or moves files
# Moving the music to another drive: copy, check, switch, remove the old copies
core/drives/**
api/drives.py
